|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Collateral Damage (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-55-Collateral_Damage-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-collateraldamage-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-55-Collateral_Damage.png]]) show the original text (see [[Collateral Damage (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Collateral Damage (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 55 (no full stop after “Dewback”): “If you just initiated battle where you have at least two characters (one a trooper and the other a leader), add two battle destiny. Opponent takes no battle damage this battle. OR ▼ one Dewback”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026), slip checked).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) ran “damage this” together as “damagethis” (kept as published) and wrote the ▼ out with a closing full stop: “If you just initiated battle where you have at least two characters (one a trooper and the other a leader), add two battle destiny. Opponent takes no battle damagethis battle. OR Deploy one Dewback from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1210_55-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
